input: # Inputs that are not XML at all. The documented stack is
# `new Tabnas().use(jsonic).use(Feed)`, so the obvious worry is that jsonic's
# own JSON/JSONIC leniency leaks through and makes `{a:1}` parse. It does not
# parse -- but neither is it rejected.
# As of the conformance-2026-08 baseline BOTH runtimes silently ACCEPT every
# row: TS returns `undefined`, Go returns `nil`, neither raises. So all six
# rows are RED in both, which is the honest reading -- a feed parser handed
# `hello` must not report success. `new Tabnas().use(Feed)` (no jsonic) and
# `new Tabnas().use(jsonic).use(Xml)` behave identically, so this is engine /
# @tabnas/xml leniency reaching through the plugin, not a jsonic leak.
# Leave these RED until the parser rejects them; do not delete them.
